strategy.primary: Curse recycling and control: land high-impact Curses on opponents, deliberately send your own Curses to the graveyard (Despotic Scepter, Claws of Gix, Braids, Perilous Research), let Lynde return them attached to you, then move one to an opponent each upkeep and draw two.
strategy.secondary: Extra upkeeps (Paradox Haze, The Ninth Doctor, Obeka) multiply Lynde's draw-two and upkeep Curses; enchantment payoffs, Curse copies and premium Grixis interaction hold the table.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Lynde, Cheerful Tormentor
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Deathtouch
Whenever a Curse is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, return it to the battlefield attached to you at the beginning of the next end step.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may attach a Curse attached to you to one of your opponents. If you do, draw two cards.

identity.why: Returns dead Curses to you and moves one each upkeep for two cards.
Extra upkeep: another move and two more cards.
Doubles damage to the cursed player.
